newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius 1996 sugar output seen at 610,000 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius 1996 sugar output seen at 610,000 tonnes.

text.p: The Mauritius Chamber of Agriculture has confirmed its initial sugar production forecast of 610,000 tonnes in 1996, authorities said on Thursday.

Some 424,949 tonnes of sugar had been produced by October 5 from 3,844,650 tonnes of cane harvested, giving an extraction rate of 11.05 percent, the Public Relations Office of the Sugar Industry (Prosi) said in a statement.
"In light of data collected as at that date, the Chamber of Agriculture confirms its initial estimate of 610,000 tonnes of sugar for the 1996 harvest," Prosi added.
Production by early October 1995 was posted at 317,529 tonnes from 3,141,268 tonnes of canes, giving an extraction rate of 10.11 percent.
Sugar production in 1995 was hit by bad weather and totalled 539,521 tonnes.
The 1996 extraction rate was rising, especially in southern regions, and was above levels attained at this stage during the past five years, Prosi added.
But this was offset by a decline in yield per hectare over the past the past few weeks in southern and central regions.
